diff --git a/stocklib/report.py b/stocklib/report.py
index 7e6d7f2..83847b3 100644
--- a/stocklib/report.py
+++ b/stocklib/report.py
@@ -1,4 +1,6 @@
 """Plain-text reports over a Ledger."""
+import csv
+import io
 
 
 def totals(ledger):
@@ -9,3 +11,12 @@ def summary(ledger):
     lines = [f"{sku}: {ledger.quantity(sku)}" for sku in ledger.skus()]
     lines.append(f"TOTAL {totals(ledger)}")
     return "\n".join(lines)
+
+
+def to_csv(ledger):
+    out = io.StringIO()
+    writer = csv.writer(out, lineterminator="\n")
+    writer.writerow(["sku", "quantity"])
+    for sku in sorted(ledger.skus()):
+        writer.writerow([sku, ledger.quantity(sku)])
+    return out.getvalue()
